standings.blurb: 7-1, best all-play record in the league (74-30), most points (1,019.4). Smoked Big Dabolls 132.74 to 75.9 in last week's game of the week. 75% to lock up the 1 seed. This is a dynasty with a waiver wire.
Four straight wins and a 143.3 average over the last three. Just hung 143.78 on Rat for the biggest blowout in league history. Burrow dropped 39.5. Somebody call the fire department.
3-5 with the third-most points in the league and a 67-37 all-play record. Left 37.3 on the bench and still won by 46.76. More than two games of bad luck, and the sims still give him 78.5% to make it.
5-3, two straight wins and the best rest-of-season roster on paper. Ja'Marr Chase went for 31.1, Kirk Cousins 28.2. 96.8% playoff odds and a 37.4-point favorite this week.
5-3 after surviving Brighton by 2.76. But the last three weeks average 92.8, and only two teams have had more points scored against them. Winning ugly is still winning.
Lost 142.18 to 108 to a team that hadn't won since Week 1. Baker Mayfield scored 1.4. The kicker scored zero. Playoff odds fell from 77.9% to 63.5%, and now here come the 7-1 DBC's.
Two straight losses and a 75.9 against the DBC's. DK Metcalf 1.4, Kyle Pitts 2.6, Samaje Perine 2.9. Still 5-3, still the third-luckiest team in the league, still 85.8% to get in.
5-3 and the luckiest team in the league (+1.46 wins). But 134.88 last week was no fluke: Tee Higgins 37.5, Michael Wilson 26.8, Jonah Coleman 20.4. Playoff odds nearly doubled to 70.3%.
Started Lamar Jackson and got zero. Benched Tyler Allgeier and his 36.1. Lost by 50.48. The last three weeks average 88.3, and playoff odds just dropped from 81.7% to 65.2%.
The six-game losing streak is DEAD. 142.18, second-best score of the week, with Tony Pollard at 28.7. Still 2-6 and 5.2% to make it, but at least the bleeding stopped.
53.06. Third-lowest score in league history, and the losing end of the biggest blowout ever. Emmett Johnson scored 25.3 on the bench. Last three weeks: 74.2 a game, worst in the league.
Lost by 2.76 with Kenny Gainwell's 14.0 on the bench and Zach Charbonnet's 5.9 in the lineup. The best lineup would have won. 4-4 and 11.3% to make it.
2-6, two straight losses, 0.8% playoff odds. Brock Bowers (28.2) and Drake Maye (22.5) showed up. The receivers combined for 10.4 while Rome Odunze and Jordan Addison sat on the bench with 24.3.
1-7 and six straight losses. Started two receivers who scored zero. The unluckiest team in the league at −2.54 wins, but the 73.5 last week was all on the roster.

previews.take: The O'Dons have won four straight and averaged 143.3 over the last three. The Park is 2-6 with 0.8% playoff odds. Burrow (21.4) and Lamb (20.3) project like a team that smells a first-round bye. Matthew needs Bowers to go nuclear again.

The Overload is 3-5 with the third-most points in the league and the highest projection on the board after Vert. The anomaly's are 5-3 but averaging 92.8 over the last three. If Trevor starts the right guys this time, this could get ugly.

Rat just scored 53.06 and Goobz just scored 84.4 with Tyler Allgeier's 36.1 on the bench. Somebody has to win. Rat gets Kenneth Walker (23.0) and Brock Purdy (22.1); Goobz needs Bijan to be Bijan again after 7.6 last week.

Game of the week. The 7-1 DBC's project for 119.6, Trust The Process for 116.8. Puka Nacua (24.1) vs Jaxon Smith-Njigba (22.8) is the headliner. TTP just lost to a team on a six-game skid. Beat the best team in the league and all is forgiven.

A-Rock finally won. Holden is 5-3 and the luckiest team in the league. A-Rock is a 5.6-point favorite behind Jayden Daniels (19.8), and needs every win it can get at 2-6. Holden needs Higgins to do Week 8 things again.

The biggest line of the week: Vert by 37.4. Vert has Ja'Marr Chase (22.9) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (20.6). Stone Cold has lost six straight and projects for 100.1. Danny, the bench is not a place to keep points. Start everybody who's breathing.

Brighton gets Big Dabolls a week after shipping Luther Burden there for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen. Allen scored 23.3 in his first game for Jalen rams me. Burden scored 18.6 for Ben. Dabolls is a 14.6-point favorite and Brighton is running out of weeks.

headlines.title: Dons trade Dons: Antonio Williams goes to Stone Cold for Tyson
headlines.dek: Trade No. 55 sends a 7.8-point-a-game receiver to the 1-7 Stone Cold Dons for a receiver who hasn't scored a point this season.
body: Trade No. 55 went through at 12:48 p.m. Friday, the first deal between the league's two Dons. Zach O'Donoghue's Fighting O'Dons sent Antonio Williams to Danny Stevens' Stone Cold Dons for Jordyn Tyson. Williams has 54.9 points in seven games, 7.84 a game, and scored 10.4 on the O'Dons' bench last week. Tyson has zero. He spent Weeks 6 through 8 in the Stone Cold Dons' IR slot and is still listed on injured reserve.

Neither lineup changes yet. Williams lands on the 1-7 Dons' bench projected for 10.1, a point more than flex starter Ryan Flournoy (9.0), with his new team down 27.5-0 to Vert after Thursday. Tyson goes to the 5-3 O'Dons' bench because Michael Pittman Jr. already has their IR spot. ESPN projects Williams for 97.3 more points this season and Tyson for 58.7. “It's a Dons thing,” a league source said. “You wouldn't understand.”

headlines.title: Brighton's 24th trade ships Garrett Wilson to Rat after 46 hours
headlines.dek: Jalen rams me gets Breece Hall and Ladd McConkey for Wilson and Carnell Tate, and Trust The Process trades for a quarterback it had cut that morning.
body: Trade No. 53 went through Thursday afternoon: Brighton Caushaj sent Garrett Wilson and Carnell Tate to Elijah Dembe's Rat for Breece Hall and Ladd McConkey. Wilson arrived from the anomaly's on Tuesday and left 46 hours later without playing a down for Jalen rams me. Both newcomers start right away against Big Dabolls, Hall at RB (10.9 projected) and McConkey at WR (10.8), with Big Dabolls already up 13.58-0 after Thursday night. Rat puts Wilson (14.2 a game, questionable) at flex; Tate is out and on the bench. It's Brighton's 24th trade of the season. "He doesn't build a roster, he leases one," a league source said.

Trade No. 54 was a quarterback round trip. Trust The Process added Deshaun Watson Wednesday, cut him Thursday morning, and watched the Stone Cold Dons pick him up by lunch. That evening John Reese sent Joe Fagnano, a same-day pickup, to the Dons to get Watson back, then cut Watson again at 10:53 p.m. Fagnano scored -0.3 on the Dons' bench Thursday night. Bo Nix stays TTP's starter. The lineup impact on both sides is zero, and so far that's the best number in the deal.

headlines.title: Jaguars 33, Ravens 10: Vert banks 27.5, Henry and Flowers stall
headlines.dek: Thursday night went to Jacksonville, and so did the league's points: Vert's kicker outscored every Raven in an LFPFFL lineup.
body: Cam Little kicked his way to 17.0 and Jakobi Meyers added 10.5, so Vert leads Stone Cold Dons 27.5-0 with seven starters left to nine. The Overload's Jaguars D/ST put up 12.0 for a 12.0-9.78 lead on the anomaly’s, whose Derrick Henry managed 5.58 against a 15.81 average.

Zay Flowers (5.3) still has Rat up 5.3-0 on Team Goobz, and Trevor Lawrence's 13.58 has Big Dabolls up on Jalen rams me. The best Raven went unused: Justice Hill scored 18.2 on The Park's bench, 4.1 more than starter Parker Washington. The Park leads the O'Dons 14.1-0 anyway. “We liked the matchup,” a team source said. “We just liked it from the bench.”

headlines.title: The anomaly’s are 5-3 and have been outscored by 37.5 points
headlines.dek: John Francis has the only winning record in the league with a negative point differential, and this week he gets the team built the opposite way.
body: The anomaly’s have scored 912.9 points and allowed 950.4. Every other team above .500 is in the black. The last three weeks average 92.8, and the latest win was a 2.76-point escape from Brighton.

This week it’s The Overload: 3-5, plus-53.8, third in the league in points and second-unluckiest at −2.15 wins. The projections have Trevor by 9.0 and at 61% to win, with Jahmyr Gibbs (26.5) the anomaly’s’ best hope. “We don’t look at point differential,” a team source said. “We look at the standings. The standings are going great.”

headlines.title: LFPFFL plans spring election for commissioner, punishment committee, Instagram
headlines.dek: League sources say managers will vote in March or April 2027 to fill five offices: a commissioner, three punishment-committee seats and the league's first Instagram manager.
body: The LFPFFL is heading to the polls. According to people familiar with the planning, the offseason vote will fill a single commissioner seat, a three-person punishment committee and a brand-new Instagram manager job. Nobody can say yet whether one person can hold two offices.

Early names are already circulating. Elijah Dembe is the first name floated for the punishment committee, a week after Rat put up 53.06. Nobody knows the subject better. For commissioner, both Johns are in the mix, John Reese and John Francis, which would at least keep the ballot simple. And Matthew Reese has reportedly asked for the Instagram job. The Park is 2-6, which leaves plenty of Sundays open for content.
Term lengths and campaign rules are still undecided. "Nothing is settled," one manager said, "except that nobody's running unopposed."

headlines.title: The 4-4 logjam all lost Sunday, and 3-5 Overload likes its odds
headlines.dek: Seeds 7 through 10 went a combined 0-4 in Week 8, while the team below them has better playoff odds than any of them.
body: Trust The Process, Team Goobz, Rat and Jalen rams me all lost in Week 8 and sit at 4-4, holding seeds 7 through 10 on points alone. Their playoff odds run from 65.2% (Goobz) down to 11.3% (Jalen rams me). Rat and Goobz play each other Sunday, so one of them leaves the logjam either way.

One spot back, The Overload is 3-5 with 985.7 points, third in the league, and a 67-37 all-play record. The simulations give Trevor Illson's team 78.5% playoff odds, better than all four 4-4 teams and 5-3 Aaron Rodgers LSD (70.3%). "We're the best 3-5 team in America," a team source said. Nobody has checked.

headlines.title: Week 8's zero club: six starters, five teams, one survivor
headlines.dek: Lamar Jackson, Zay Flowers and four others put up nothing Sunday, and only The Overload won anyway.
body: Six starters finished Week 8 with exactly 0.0 points, and they were projected for 85.1 combined. Lamar Jackson (22.2 projected) and Zay Flowers (20.1) led the walk-ons; Team Goobz lost by 50.48 and Rat by 90.72. Stone Cold Dons doubled up with Omar Cooper Jr. and Tez Johnson and lost by 46.76 to fall to 1-7. Trust The Process got nothing from kicker Will Reichard and 1.4 from Baker Mayfield in a 142.18-108 loss to A-Rock Balls.

The lone survivor: The Overload started Tre Tucker, got zero, and beat Stone Cold Dons 120.26-73.5 anyway. "We consider him a decoy," a team source said. The league office says the zero club meets weekly. Attendance has been strong.

headlines.title: Bo Nix grades out a C- for Trust The Process; Brighton wins
headlines.dek: Trades No. 51 and 52 are graded: John Reese's new quarterback projects below replacement level, and Brighton takes the four-player swap with the anomaly's.
body: Trust The Process started Baker Mayfield in Week 8 and got 1.4 points. With Jalen Hurts on IR, John Reese sent Khalil Shakir to Aaron Rodgers LSD for Bo Nix. The lineup math is brutal: Nix projects 14.76 a week, the league's replacement-level QB (the 15th-best rostered) projects 15.77. That's -9.1 over the rest of the season and a C- for TTP. LSD gets a C+ at 0.0: Caleb Williams (17.03) stays under center and Shakir (10.24) doesn't crack their projected lineup. Nobody got fleeced, but nobody got better either.

Four hours later Brighton Caushaj won his swap with John Francis. Jalen rams me gets Garrett Wilson and Malik Washington for Jaylen Waddle and Braelon Allen, and Wilson (11.95 a week) slides into a lineup where Allen (9.16) used to be. Brighton: +10.7, a B. The anomaly's: -12.4, a D+, with Waddle (10.50) taking Wilson's starting spot. Allen spent four days in Brighton and leaves with a D+ stapled to his new team's ledger.

storylines.title: Luck report
storylines.body: Unluckiest: Danny Stevens (−2.54 wins) and Trevor Illson (−2.15). Luckiest: Holden Wright (+1.46), lukas bosefski (+1.31) and Ben Frey (+1.08). Holden is 5-3 on a 46-58 all-play record.

rings.blurb: Before ESPN kept the receipts, Zach O'Donoghue beat Alex Reese for the 2021 title. No box scores survive, just the ring. A year later he did it again to the same guy, which makes Zach the league's only two-time champ and Alex the first manager to lose two finals.
Back-to-back. Same final, same victim: Zach beat Alex Reese again, this time by 70.1, the biggest title-game beatdown on record. By our all-time rankings it's still the best season anyone has had.

Zach's two-year reign is over. A .500 Ben Frey team went all-in at midseason, pried CeeDee Lamb loose from Holden Wright, and rode him to the league's first new champion. Lamb dropped 40.2 in the final and Ben won it by 4.16. Ballsy as hell, and it paid off.

Trust the process, literally. The unluckiest team in the league that year (2.9 wins below what its scores earned) snuck in as the 7 seed and then went nuclear. 178.48 in the final is the highest-scoring title game on record. Process complete. Elijah lost his second straight final.

In 2024 Trevor finished dead last, posted the worst season in league history, and served the league punishment. One year later he took a 6-8 team, grabbed the 7 seed and won the whole damn thing. Stevenson put up 27.2 in the final. From punishment to champion in twelve months.

rivalries.blurb: The grudge with a ring in it. John beat Elijah in the 2024 championship, 178.48 to 163.66, and in the 2022 third-place game, where Rat put up a historically sad 22.48. Elijah got one back in Week 4 this year, 144.12 to 120.82. Week 12 decides who gets to talk.
rivalries.name: The Man vs The Mouse

rivalries.blurb: Matthew owns this one, 5-2, including both postseason meetings. Holden finally won in Week 4 this year, 82.46 to 61.82, in one of the ugliest games the league has ever seen: 144.28 combined points. Both of these teams should be embarrassed.
rivalries.name: The Corporate Bowl

rivalries.blurb: The tightest series on the board. Ben leads 3-2, the total points are separated by 26.7 across five games, and Ben took Week 4 this year, 101.88 to 92.30. Danny is 1-6 and a Week 12 upset would make his whole damn season.
rivalries.name: The Battle For The Park

rivalries.blurb: Zach leads 2-1, and the one that hurts is the 2025 playoff game: Zach dropped 172.56 and buried John Francis by 68.6. John Francis got revenge in Week 4 this year by 2.74, 140.56 to 137.82. Week 12 is the rubber match.
rivalries.name: The Living Room Bowl

rivalries.blurb: Vert leads 4-2 and just hung 161.6 on Alex in Week 4, a 73.9-point beatdown and Vert's best score of the year. Both of Alex's wins came in 2025. A-Rock is 1-6 and needs a miracle in Week 12.
rivalries.name: The Cardio Bowl

rivalries.blurb: The newest rivalry and already spicy. lukas knocked Brighton out of the 2025 semifinals by 3.24 points, then beat him again by 20.8 in Week 4 this year. Brighton won the first meeting and hasn't won since.
rivalries.name: The Keyboard Bowl

rivalries.blurb: The most-played rivalry in the league: 10 meetings. Bosefski leads 6-4 and has won three straight, including a 146.86 to 68.18 consolation-game massacre in 2024. Trevor won the 2023 third-place game. Week 4 this year went to Goobz by 2.86.
rivalries.name: The Uck Bowl

rows.blurb: The defending champ is running a MASH unit. 19 injuries in 2022 is still the single-season record, and he still won it all a year later. Built different, or just built out of glass.

Tied for the crown and the worst luck with stars in league history. Lost Jalen Hurts in Week 15 of 2022 right before the playoffs. Lost Lamar this year. The man's roster should come with a waiver form.
Leads 2026 with 7 already, and his count has gone up four years straight: 5, 10, 12, 15. Whatever he's feeding these guys, stop.
Lost Josh Allen in Week 16 of 2022. That one still hurts.
15 in 2022, then a clean 5 the next year. Cooper Kupp lasted two weeks in 2024.
Never the worst, never safe. Already at 5 this year, third-most in the league.
Zero injuries in 2026. Nobody else can say that.
Lost Pittman in Week 1 of 2022, then had the healthiest season on record in 2025 with just 3.
One injury in 2026 and the best roster in the league by projection. Healthy and loaded.
Mostly healthy, though Zay Flowers went down in Week 1 this year.
Below average after a rough 2022, when he lost Burrow in Week 16 and Chase in Week 7. Clean ever since.
Better every year since joining: 12, 10, 6. He trades players away before they can get hurt.
One season, 14 injuries, worst rate ever. He saw enough.
Garrett Wilson went down twice in one season. Otherwise a clean bill of health.
The healthiest roster in the league at 5.7 a season. Part of why he leads the league in all-play.

archive.title: On Brighton's schedule, 13 of 14 teams would be .500 or better
archive.dek: Jalen rams me is 4-4 against the league's second-softest schedule. Give it to everyone else and only one team finishes under .500.
body: Brighton Caushaj's opponents have averaged 102.2 points a week (817.5 total), the second-easiest schedule in the league. Only Holden Wright's (812.0) has been softer. We gave every team Jalen rams me's eight opponents and replayed the season.

The DBC's go 8-0. Fighting O'Dons and the anomaly's go 7-1. Vert, Trust The Process and the Overload go 6-2, which would move Trevor up from 3-5. Stone Cold Dons go from 1-7 to 5-3, and A-Rock (2-6) and Aaron Rodgers LSD finish 5-3 too. Team Goobz, Big Dabolls and Rat land at 4-4, alongside Brighton himself. Only The Park does worse, at 3-5.

Brighton has scored 792.5 points, second-fewest in the league. The schedule is doing the heavy lifting; Brighton is doing the trading. (When a team would have played itself, it gets Jalen rams me's score that week instead.)

archive.title: 143.78 to 53.06: the O'Dons just put up the biggest blowout in LFPFFL history
archive.dek: A 90.72-point beatdown breaks Goobz's 2025 record. Rat's 53.06 is the third-lowest score the league has ever seen.
body: Holy hell. Zach O'Donoghue beat Elijah Dembe by 90.72 points, wiping out the old blowout record of 89.38 (Goobz over A-Rock, Week 12 of 2025). Joe Burrow threw up 39.5, Bucky Irving added 21.0 and DJ Moore 16.6. That's four straight wins for the O'Dons, who are 5-3 and averaging 143.3 over the last three weeks.

Rat's 53.06 is the third-lowest score in league history, behind Danny Stevens' 50.6 in 2022 and Brighton's 51.84 in Week 1 this year. Zay Flowers scored zero. Jacoby Brissett scored 3.5. Jordan Mason 2.0, Tyler Higbee 2.4, Trey Smack 3.0, Rashod Bateman 3.2. Meanwhile Emmett Johnson put up 25.3 on the bench. The Commanders D/ST led all Rat starters with 14.
Even the best possible Rat lineup scored 78.36 and still loses by 65. That's not a bad week, that's a crime scene.

archive.title: The Overload benched 37.3 points and STILL won by 46
archive.dek: Harold Fannin scored 23.4 on the bench. Trevor's best lineup was 157.56, higher than anybody scored all week.
body: Trevor Illson beat Stone Cold Dons 120.26 to 73.5 and somehow made it look like a disappointment. Harold Fannin Jr. dropped 23.4 from the bench while Dallas Goedert started and scored 7.2. Wan'Dale Robinson had 15.7 on the bench while Tre Tucker (0) and Drake London (1.8) started. The optimal Overload lineup was 157.56. The highest real score of the week was 143.78.
Josh Allen (26.6) and Chuba Hubbard (24.9) carried the actual lineup. The Overload is 3-5 with the third-most points in the league, and the sims still give Trevor a 78.5% playoff shot.
Danny Stevens is 1-7 and has lost six straight, tying the third-longest skid in league history. Omar Cooper Jr. and Tez Johnson both started and both scored zero. Ryan Flournoy had 13.1 on the bench.

archive.title: Brighton loses by 2.76 with the winning points on his bench
archive.dek: Kenny Gainwell scored 14.0 on the pine. Zach Charbonnet started and scored 5.9. The anomaly's escape 118.06 to 115.3.
body: The closest game of Week 8 was decided before kickoff. Brighton Caushaj started Zach Charbonnet (5.9) over Kenny Gainwell (14.0). That swap alone is 8.1 points, almost three times the margin. Jalen rams me's best lineup was 124.0. They scored 115.3. John Francis won with 118.06.

The new guy delivered, at least. Braelon Allen, who came over from Big Dabolls on Friday, scored 23.3 in his first start, and Josh Jacobs added 23.2. Jahmyr Gibbs (24.8) led the anomaly's, who are 5-3.
Brighton is 4-4 with 11.3% playoff odds, and the schedule hands him Big Dabolls next. The bench is still undefeated.

archive.title: Holden's Oct. 27 deal flips from a C- to an A after one huge Sunday
archive.dek: Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman put up 47.2 in their first week with Aaron Rodgers LSD. The Overload's side falls to a D.
body: The weekly trade re-grade has a new winner. A week ago, Holden Wright's swap with The Overload (Wan'Dale Robinson, Rachaad White and Marvin Harrison Jr. for Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman) graded out as a C- for Holden. Then Wilson scored 26.8 and Coleman 20.4. Holden's side is now +43.5 for an A. Trevor Illson's side is −29.6, a D, with Robinson's 15.7 stuck on his bench and Harrison at zero.

Brighton's Friday deal with Big Dabolls (Luther Burden and Samaje Perine for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen) is now a C+ on both sides, +0.8 for Brighton and +0.6 for Ben. Sunday's Courtland Sutton for Eli Raridon trade grades out as a B for Ben (+6.4) and a C+ for John Reese (0.0).
On the season ledger, the Fighting O'Dons lead at +229.5 over 11 deals. Jalen rams me (22 trades, −258.8) and Stone Cold Dons (12 trades, −276.2) bring up the rear.

archive.title: Aaron Rodgers LSD drops 134.88 on Goobz, and the new guys did it
archive.dek: Tee Higgins went for 37.5. Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman, a week after arriving, added 47.2. Goobz started Lamar Jackson and got zero.
body: Holden Wright's team has been the league's favorite fraud all year. Not this week. Tee Higgins scored 37.5, Michael Wilson 26.8 and Jonah Coleman 20.4 in a 134.88 to 84.4 beatdown. Holden is 5-3 and his playoff odds nearly doubled, from 36.5% to 70.3%.

Team Goobz, meanwhile, set themselves on fire. Lamar Jackson started and scored zero. Tyler Allgeier scored 36.1 on the bench. Bijan Robinson managed 7.6. The best Goobz lineup was 115.7, which still loses, but by a lot less than 50.48.
Christopher Bosefski is 4-4, averaging 88.3 over the last three weeks, and his playoff odds just fell from 81.7% to 65.2%.

archive.title: The 7-1 DBC's get Trust The Process, fresh off a beating from A-Rock
archive.dek: lukas bosefski projects for 119.6, John Reese for 116.8. The DBC's are 75.2% to take the 1 seed.
body: The DBC's just ran over Big Dabolls 132.74 to 75.9 in last week's game of the week. Bhayshul Tuten scored 29.9, Puka Nacua 25.0 and Trey McBride 20.2. lukas bosefski leads the league in points (1,019.4) and all-play record (74-30).

Trust The Process is coming off a 142.18 to 108 loss to an A-Rock team that hadn't won since Week 1. Tony Pollard had 28.7 for Alex Reese. Baker Mayfield scored 1.4 for John, and Will Reichard scored zero. Jaxon Smith-Njigba did his part with 23.8.
The line is DBC's by 2.8, and the DBC's win 54% of the time. Nacua (24.1 projected) against Smith-Njigba (22.8) is the matchup to watch. Vote below.

archive.title: John Reese flips Courtland Sutton to Big Dabolls for Eli Raridon
archive.dek: Trade No. 50 of 2026 went through 17 minutes before Sunday's 1 p.m. kickoffs, and both players spent Week 8 on their new team's bench.
body: Sunday at 12:43 p.m., Trust The Process sent receiver Courtland Sutton to Ben Frey for tight end Eli Raridon. It's the first trade between the two franchises this season, and on paper it's a wash: both players average 6.0 points a game. Neither started in Week 8. Sutton scored 9.3 on the Big Dabolls' bench while DK Metcalf scored 1.4 at flex, and Raridon scored 1.5 behind Tucker Kraft. Both teams lost anyway, by 34.18 and 56.84.

The point of the deal is depth. Metcalf is projected for zero in Week 9, so Sutton (8.9 projected) is in Frey's flex conversation against Jalen rams me, the team he traded with on Friday. Reese now has two tight ends and seven receivers going into a game against the 7-1 DBC's. "Everybody needs a TE2," a team source said. Kraft is projected for 10.7.

archive.title: WTF is going on with Rat
archive.dek: Elijah Dembe has 39.06 points and one player left. The lowest score in LFPFFL history is 50.6.
body: Rat's only player left is the Commanders D/ST, projected for 6.9. That puts Elijah Dembe on pace for about 46 points, which would break Danny Stevens' all-time low of 50.6 from Week 6 of 2022. To stay out of the record book, the Commanders need at least 11.6 points. They've averaged 3.8 this year.

How it happened: Zay Flowers was projected for 20.1 and scored zero. Jacoby Brissett started at quarterback and scored 3.5. Jordan Mason had 2.0, Tyler Higbee 2.4 and Trey Smack 3.0. Emmett Johnson scored 25.3, more than any Rat starter, from the bench.

Across the field, Zach O'Donoghue has 119.88 with three players left and projects to about 146. If that holds, the margin would also beat the blowout record, Goobz's 89.38 over A-Rock in 2025. Two records, one Sunday. Both teams came in 4-3.

archive.title: Brighton trails The anomaly’s by 10.36, needs Lemon and Charbonnet
archive.dek: Week 8's only live game goes through Philadelphia tonight and Seattle on Monday; the other six are mostly paperwork.
body: Brighton Caushaj's Jalen rams me sit at 97.70, 10.36 behind John Francis and The anomaly’s (108.06), two 4-3 teams with a grudge from Thursday. Brighton has Makai Lemon (10.2 projected) tonight and Zach Charbonnet (10.4) Monday. Francis has only the Bears D/ST (5.8), also Monday. ESPN projects 118.30 to 113.86, Brighton.

Trevor Illson leads Danny Stevens 86.26-73.50 with three starters left; Stevens is finished. Samuel Vert has 112.88 to Matthew Reese's final 87.96 despite benching Patrick Mahomes' 25.44. Alex Reese leads John Reese 127.20-84.20 with Jayden Daniels still to play.
The rest are over. Christopher Bosefski trails Holden Wright 120.90-54.50 with Tyler Allgeier's 36.1 on his bench. "We'll look at it," a team source said.

archive.title: Saquon Barkley, traded five times, asks O'Dons for a no-trade clause
archive.dek: The Fighting O'Dons are his fourth team and sixth stop of 2026. On Sunday he faces Rat, stop No. 2.
body: Sources say Barkley's camp approached Zach O'Donoghue this week about a no-trade clause, which the LFPFFL does not have. Barkley went 16th overall to The Park and has since been dealt to Rat, Jalen rams me, back to The Park, back to Jalen rams me and, on Oct. 14, to the O'Dons. He has 38.1 points this season, 7.6 a game, just behind bench back Rico Dowdle's 8.3. He's questionable and still in Sunday's lineup against Rat. "He just wants to unpack," a league source said.

archive.title: Draft retro: The Overload drafted well and went 2-5 anyway
archive.dek: Trevor Illson's seventh-round pick Chuba Hubbard has outscored Ja'Marr Chase and Drake London, and 15th-rounder Jordan Love is second among drafted quarterbacks.
body: Through Thursday night, the top of the 2026 draft board has aged unevenly. De'Von Achane went 12th overall and has 24.6 points; he's on IR and on waivers. A.J. Brown went 21st, scored 19.1 and was traded Friday. The late rounds were kinder. Jordan Love went 205th overall to Big Dabolls and has 148.8 points, second among drafted quarterbacks.

The best draft may belong to a 2-5 team. The Overload took Josh Allen 35th (161.3 points, first among drafted QBs) and Chuba Hubbard 91st (133.0, more than Drake London at 13th or Ja'Marr Chase at 3rd). Eleventh-rounder Tre Tucker has 99.8. Trevor's team has the third-most points in the league and two wins. "The draft was the easy part," a team source said.

archive.title: The anomaly’s Oct. 14 trade haul is sitting together on the bench
archive.dek: Justin Herbert, Keenan Allen and Tyreek Hill came over from the O'Dons for Matthew Stafford. None of them is starting in Week 8.
body: Two weeks after John Francis sent Matthew Stafford and Dohnte Meyers to the Fighting O'Dons, the entire return is on the bench. Herbert (10.4 a game) sits behind Bryce Young (18.0). Keenan Allen (10.1) can't crack a lineup that starts Tetairoa McMillan and Garrett Wilson. Tyreek Hill has zero points this season.

Team sources say the three have started sitting together at practice. "Veteran presence," Francis said when asked what they bring. He has made 10 trades this season, and five of his seven bench spots are now receivers. Hill's locker, one source noted, is the cleanest on the team.

archive.title: Luther Burden gets his wish: Brighton ships him to Big Dabolls
archive.dek: Trade No. 22: Burden and Samaje Perine go to Ben Frey for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen, two days after the Rumor Mill said Burden wanted out.
body: Wednesday, the Wire reported Luther Burden wanted out of Jalen rams me. By Friday at noon he was gone: Brighton Caushaj sent Burden (13.9 a game) and Samaje Perine to Big Dabolls for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen. It's Brighton's 22nd trade of the season. We had Big Dabolls at "everyone else, +1000."

Thursday's report that Ben Frey's patience with A.J. Brown was running out turned out to be accurate. Brown is questionable again and averaging 6.4 a game. The lineup math still likes Brighton's side, +7.1 points the rest of the way for a B, because Brown projects for 151 more points, the most of anyone in the deal. Ben takes a C- (−7.1) and a receiver who actually shows up.
Both teams are mid-game. Big Dabolls leads the DBC's 17.3 to 9.6, and Jalen rams me is up on the anomaly's 23.2 to 22.2.

archive.title: Christian Watson went to the hospital, then came back for 113 yards
archive.dek: Thursday's Packers-Panthers game touched nine LFPFFL rosters, and Ben Frey's receiver took an ambulance ride in the middle of it.
body: Watson caught a 53-yarder in the first half, took a hit to the chest and left in an ambulance for precautionary tests. He was back by the third quarter and finished with 8 catches for 113 yards. That's a strong start to Big Dabolls' first-place showdown with the DBC's, who answered with Jalen Coker's 26-yard touchdown on fourth down. Jordan Love threw for 288 yards and three scores, from Ben's bench.

Brighton had the best night. Josh Jacobs ran for just 39 yards and still scored twice, on a run and a catch. Two days after Jalen rams me's coach supposedly fired shots at the anomaly's, John Francis watched Bryce Young get sacked six times (209 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT).

Elsewhere: Tucker Kraft caught a touchdown for Trust The Process. The Overload-Stone Cold Dons game is even, with Chuba Hubbard (81 rushing yards, a TD, 7 catches) for Trevor and Matthew Golden (7 for 79 and a TD) for Danny. Rat's kicker, Trey Smack, missed an extra point. The Park's Panthers D picked off Love once and gave up 27.

archive.title: Jalen rams me coach fires shots at the anomaly’s before Sunday
archive.dek: Asked about facing the anomaly’s head coach this week, the Jalen rams me coach kept it to five words, and three of them needed asterisks.
body: Asked Thursday how he felt about going up against the anomaly’s head coach, the Jalen rams me coach didn't need long. "F*ck that soft a** b*tch," he said, and left the podium. A team spokesman later said the comments "speak for themselves."

The numbers don't exactly back him up. Jalen rams me is 4-3 on a three-game win streak, but its 677.2 points rank 13th in the league. The anomaly’s are also 4-3, with 794.8, and are projected to win 126.7 to 104.6, with 73% win odds. Their locker room held a players-only meeting Tuesday. Now it has a new topic.

archive.title: Ben Frey's patience with A.J. Brown is running out
archive.dek: Brown is questionable again, his backup is on bye, and the Big Dabolls play the 6-1 DBC's on Sunday.
body: Sources describe Ben Frey as "beyond frustrated" with A.J. Brown, his draft-day receiver, who is listed questionable again and is averaging 6.4 points a game across three appearances. The obvious fix would be Devaughn Vele, who scored 16.4 in Week 7 and averages 12.3. Vele is on bye.

So if Brown sits, the likeliest plan is moving DK Metcalf into his spot and starting a tight end, Eli Raridon (projected 7.8), at flex. "I drafted a wide receiver," Frey said, staring at the injury report. "I'd love to see one."

archive.title: Goobz's newest stars can't help, so Treylon Burks gets the flex
archive.dek: Christopher Bosefski traded for Davante Adams and David Montgomery within a week. This week they're projected for a combined zero.
body: Adams (17.0 a game) arrived from Stone Cold Dons on Oct. 24 and is on IR. Montgomery (9.1 a game) came over from Jalen rams me on Tuesday and is projected for zero in Week 8. So as of Thursday, the flex spot belongs to Treylon Burks, a waiver pickup from the same day as the Adams deal, at 7.2 a game. "We're built for December," Bosefski said.
Team Goobz (4-3) face Aaron Rodgers LSD (4-3) on Sunday. Burks is listed questionable.

archive.title: The anomaly’s call players-only meeting after two-game skid
archive.dek: After 70.92 points against Rat, sources say the locker room decided it was time to talk, and the coaching staff wasn't invited.
body: The anomaly’s held a players-only meeting Tuesday, according to a league source, after scoring 89.44 and 70.92 in back-to-back losses that dropped John Francis's team to 4-3. Two weeks earlier, the same group put up 153.82. Nine of the 16 players on the roster arrived by trade, and the meeting reportedly opened with introductions.

Jahmyr Gibbs, averaging 28.5 a game, is said to have done most of the talking. "We've got Justin Herbert on the bench," one player in the room said. "Think about that." Next up is Jalen rams me, also 4-3. The door stayed closed. Francis was heard knocking.

archive.title: Luther Burden wants OUT of Jalen rams me
archive.dek: Twelve days after arriving in the Amon-Ra deal, the hottest piece of Brighton's haul has asked for a trade. Sources say he found out about the other 20 trades.
body: Do the math. Burden came over from Vert on Oct 16 as part of the St. Brown blockbuster, dropped 23.7 in his Jalen rams me debut, and is averaging 13.9 a game this season. Then he looked around the locker room. Josh Jacobs got here the same day. Josh Downs got here last night. David Montgomery left last night. Brighton Caushaj has made 21 trades this year, and his ledger is −163 lineup points. Nobody unpacks in this building. Burden's camp reportedly wants 'stability,' which in this league means a manager with fewer than ten trades.

Brighton's problem: Burden is his WR1. His 145 rest-of-season points are the best of any receiver on the roster, ahead of Carnell Tate (121) and Jaylen Waddle (112). Moving him for anything less than a starter blows a hole in a 4-3 team. Moving him at all is trade number 22. You know he's taking calls.

THE BOARD. Front-runner: The DBC's (+200). lukas bosefski is 6-1 with Puka Nacua and Jalen Coker, but his WR3 is KC Concepcion (111 ROS), and he has made exactly two trades all year. Fresh blood, deep pockets, a title to chase. Next up: Aaron Rodgers LSD (+300). Holden has three receivers on the whole roster after consolidating into Michael Wilson; one bye week and he's starting a ghost. Fighting O'Dons (+400): Zach O'Donoghue has never seen a trade he didn't like, 11 of them and +166 points on the ledger, so never count him out. Team Goobz (+600): Christopher Bosefski just fleeced Brighton for Montgomery and might want seconds. Everyone else: +1000. Stone Cold Dons need him most (WR2 is Omar Cooper Jr. at 98) but at 1-6 they're buying lottery tickets, not receivers.

archive.title: Three deals in 24 hours: Trevor goes shopping, Goobz steals Montgomery
archive.dek: The Overload takes Rachaad White, Wan'Dale Robinson and Marvin Harrison Jr. off Holden's hands. Team Goobz flips Josh Downs for David Montgomery. Brighton makes it 21.
body: Trevor Illson is 2-5 and done waiting. He sent Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman to Holden Wright for White, Robinson and MHJ, and the lineup math likes it: +8.9 points the rest of the way, a B. Holden consolidates into Wilson and gets a C- for his trouble. Trevor's new strategy: buy everything.

Best deal of the bunch: Team Goobz (+18.1, B+). Christopher Bosefski turned Josh Downs into David Montgomery, a real RB2. Brighton Caushaj takes the C- (−7.2) on trade number 21. His trade ledger is now −163 points. Somebody take this man's phone.
Also on the wire: Trust The Process swapped Konata Mumpfield for Malachi Fields with The DBC's. +1.2 / −1.2. Both sides get a C+, a wash.

archive.title: Ben Frey leaves 34 points on the pine and hands Goobz a win
archive.dek: Lost by 5.4. Benched 34.1. Started a Texans defense that scored zero. Do the math, Ben, because you clearly didn't.
body: Big Dabolls walked into Week 7 at 5-1 and walked out at 5-2 with a fresh hole in the foot. Christopher Bosefski won 91.02 to 85.66, which is the kind of score that should get both teams fined.

The optimal Ben lineup scored 119.8. Cam Skattebo put up 19.1 on the bench while the Texans D/ST started and posted a clean, beautiful 0. That's the biggest bench blunder of the week, and it flipped a W into an L.
Ben's still 5-2, still third in the power rankings, and still the luckiest team in the top four (+1.2 wins above his scoring). The universe is starting to send invoices.

archive.title: Tony Pollard drops 36.5 and A-Rock still loses. Six straight, baby
archive.dek: Week 7's best player scored for the league's worst team. Zach O'Donoghue didn't care and put up 148.
body: Alex Reese finally got a monster game: Tony Pollard went for 36.5, the top individual score in the league this week. Alex put up 122.5, his best total of the season.
Zach O'Donoghue answered with 148.08, the high score of the week, behind Joe Burrow's 28.9. Fighting O'Dons have won three straight and sit second in the power rankings.
A-Rock is 1-6 with a 1.4% playoff chance. At this point Pollard should file for a trade request.

archive.title: Danny Stevens scores 129.7 and loses AGAIN. Somebody check on this man
archive.dek: Fourth-best score of the week. Still an L. Danny is 1-6 with the scoring of a 3.5-win team.
body: Stone Cold Dons put up 129.68, good enough to beat 10 of the 13 other teams in Week 7. The schedule gods sent him the DBC's, who hung 135.02.

Danny is tied with Trevor Illson for the unluckiest team in the league: −2.46 wins below what his scoring has earned. Against the weekly median he's 3-4. In real life he's 1-6, and his playoff odds are 0.4%.
Five straight losses. The man needs a hug, a priest, and a new schedule.

archive.title: The DBC's are 6-1 and nobody can touch them
archive.dek: Second year in the league, last year's runner-up, and now the clear title favorite. Trey McBride hung 27.1.
body: lukas bosefski is running the most complete team in the LFPFFL. Best all-play record (64-27), most points (886.6), best record (6-1), and a 72% chance at the No. 1 seed.
Trey McBride, already a first-ballot Hall of Famer for this franchise, went for 27.1 in the win over Danny. Puka Nacua projects 22.4 next week.
Next up: Ben Frey in the game of the week. If the DBC's win, start engraving.

archive.title: Rat wins with 85 points in the ugliest game of the year
archive.dek: Elijah Dembe 85.12, John Francis 70.92. Both teams should have to forfeit their draft picks.
body: The anomaly's put up 70.9, the lowest score of Week 7, and Rat beat them with 85.1, which is the third-lowest winning score of the entire 2026 season.
Rat is 4-3 but sits ninth in the power rankings with a .429 all-play record. Good luck charm, bad football team.
John Francis has the toughest schedule in the league so far. This week, he was his own toughest opponent.

archive.title: Brighton Caushaj is 4-3 with the 13th-best offense. How?
archive.dek: 99.4 beats Matthew Reese's 96.5. That's three straight wins for a team that scores like it's allergic to points.
body: Brighton has scored 677.2 points, 13th of 14. His all-play record is 35-56. Against the weekly median he'd be 2-5. He is 4-3.
Our math puts the odds of a team with his scores being 4-3 or better at about 23%. He's been dodging bullets like Neo.
His model-based playoff odds are 18%. Next week he's a 22-point underdog to John Francis. The bill is coming.

archive.title: Vert flattens Holden by 39.7
archive.dek: The biggest blowout of Week 7. Holden started a tight end who scored zero and benched Bo Nix's 26.2.
body: Samuel Vert won 122.9 to 83.2. Ja'Marr Chase and friends did the work; Vert has the best rest-of-season roster in the league by projection.
Holden Wright started Will Mallory at tight end and got a goose egg. Bo Nix scored 26.2 on his bench. It wouldn't have saved him, but damn.
Holden is 4-3 with the scoring of a 2.7-win team. The fraud alarm is ringing.

archive.title: Trust The Process tops The Overload; Trevor's skid hits four
archive.dek: John Reese 133.86, Trevor Illson 125.72. Jaxon Smith-Njigba went for 31.3.
body: Trust The Process has won three straight and posted its best score of the year. JSN is averaging 28.0 points a game.

Trevor Illson is the unluckiest team in football: 2-5 with the third-most points scored and a 5-2 record against the weekly median. The defending champ has a 64% playoff chance despite the record, because his roster is legit.
Trevor's schedule has been a crime scene. He'll be a 22-point favorite against Danny next week.
